summary: Resolved DS2-R2 by reading exact root-importer package versions in pnpm lockfiles and emitting lockfile_unreadable for malformed Yarn or pnpm YAML-like lockfiles.

resolutions.result: The pnpm importer now has lockfile precedence over package entries and package.json; malformed Yarn/pnpm syntax produces an explicit diagnostic while retaining the declared value only as a fallback value.

validation.command: corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular build && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular test && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular check
validation.details: 33 Angular tests passed, including root importer precedence and malformed package-lock, Yarn and pnpm lockfile diagnostics.
